analysis: The PR changes only docs/reference/configuration.md: the 'Last updated' date, and a resource_policy_sha256 description (changed ranges 3, 964, 1104 and 1635-1636). The supplied units, head lines 314-675 of this documentation file, contain none of the changed ranges, so they hold no modified lines. I read them as unchanged surrounding context and found no new security-relevant behavior in them. They describe the schedule, model cache location, environment variables, MiMo/Qwen4/Diffusion/Bonsai controls, memory/media budgets, hashing I/O, prompt cache and the SSD prefix cache `[cache]` table. Because this is documentation only, no code, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing path changes. The cache directory and daily_write_gb text at head lines 674-675 matches T-041's existing statements: CacheVolume.inspect, no fallback, and the rolling-day ledger staying on the Mac. The doc says the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE_MEMORY row at line 485 keeps the bank off on an explicit value; this is consistent with the T-041 gating and does not weaken it. The patch excerpt for the changed hunk at ~line 964 (cluster worker resource_policy_sha256 field description) is truncated and not in the supplied units. I could not verify the cluster-policy hash text beyond the excerpt, but it describes a hash composition and not a security control change. No threat-model assumptions are invalidated by the supplied lines. Remaining question for integration: the truncated patch at lines 964, 1104 and 1635-1636 lies outside these units and was not examined.
